Marta (growth): pushed LaunchBoard staging with the new KPI view. Can folks sanity-check webinar vs inbound? :eyes:
Ryan H: quick look 12 cohort toggles work, loading fine.
Yasmin L: noticed fb_campaign sometimes maps to (not set) in exports 12 suspect trailing param/landing template trim.
Nelson S: inbound spike on 2025-04-11 doesn't match GA 12 did sampling change? @Ryan H
Ryan H: yes 12 one analytics connector had sample_rate=0.1 for ~24h, reverted yesterday.
Marta (growth): request: surface a sampling badge when sample_rate < 1 and add raw_leads + deduped_leads columns in the table/export.
dashbot: automated: sampling badge added on staging when sample_rate != 1.0; export column change queued.
Ryan H: merged PR for columns and banner 12 ETA EOD to prod. SQL ops used for sanity check:
````
select date(created_at) as day, count(*) as raw, count(distinct email) as deduped
from leads
where created_at >= '2025-04-01'
group by day
order by day desc
````
Yasmin L: will run CSV validation after deploy; already found 9 utm mismatches (trailing spaces) in recent webinar exports.
Nelson S: GA crosswalk uncovered 3 inconsistent event names between staging/prod; mapping fixed and deployed.
Marta (growth): I'll add a 1-slide note to Friday's KPI deck about the dedupe change + sampling. please confirm when validations complete.
Ryan H: deployed to prod 12 banner visible and new columns in weekly export.
Yasmin L: validation done for 2025-04-101204-14 12 logged 9 mismatches in /marketing/ops/utm-cleanup.md.
